text:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — GA showed intermittent p99 spikes on short-chat (~5% of requests). Some customers ask for session persistence/stickiness. Do we ship a small hotpatch to stabilize p99 or invest in session-stickiness for next minor?

Logan (Eng Lead): Reproduced. Spikes align with KV cache thrash from many short-lived sessions. Quick fix: tighten eviction heuristics + cap per-session open streams. Small diff, low risk.

Priya (SRE): Patch needs canary. Recommend 10% canary, monitor p99/mem/error dashboards. Gate with feature flag.

Sam (QA): We can QA a small patch in ~48h. Test matrix: session churn, reconnects, mem leak scan, perf harness regression. Need acceptance criteria.

Taylor (SE): Session-stickiness (persist session_id + KV reuse) is what customers want long-term. That's an API change + migration; not a hotpatch. Good enterprise sell but needs spec/security review.

Maya (PM): Proposal: two-track plan — 1) Immediate stabilization patch (P1): eviction tweak + cap + FF + 10% canary, target rollout within 48h. 2) Parallel: spec & design for session-stickiness for next minor (v0.2). Owners: Logan (patch); Taylor+Maya (spec). Objections?

Jamie (CS): Acme reported it and is fine with a short-term patch while we design sticky sessions. I'll capture enterprise requirements and keep them informed.

Logan (Eng Lead): I'll open PR for eviction tweak + per-session stream cap, link load tests and reproducer, include FF. Refers to issue #4321. Sample deploy snippet in PR: 
```
# enable canary feature flag (ops)
redwood feature enable session-eviction-tweak --canary 10%
```

Maya (PM): Patch acceptance criteria: p99 returns to baseline (no >200ms increase), memory increase <5% under same load, no new error regressions (errors <= baseline). Rollback if any fail.

Priya (SRE): I'll create canary dashboard and rollback alert: trigger if p99 > target OR error rate > 0.5% absolute. Adding runbook steps for rollout/rollback.

Sam (QA): Scheduling QA window and adding two automated e2e cases to perf harness (session churn, reconnect reuse). ETA: 36h for QA sign-off after PR readiness.

Taylor (SE): For session-stickiness spec draft: API header `X-Session-Id`, opt-in per-route, server-side TTL controls, migration path for clients without session ids. I'll sketch doc by EOD Friday.

Maya (PM): I'll update roadmap (sticky-session -> next minor; hotpatch -> stability bucket) and ping stakeholders when PR/spec links are live.

deploy-bot: deploy queued — canary 10% once PR merged && FF enabled.

Logan (Eng Lead): Opening issue+PR: https://redwood.internal/issue/4321 (PR will include perf runs). I'll assign rollback owner.

Jamie (CS): I'll ask Acme if they want to be in the canary cohort for early verification.

Maya (PM): Running checklist: Logan (patch+PR), Priya (dashboards/alert), Sam (QA), Taylor (spec), Jamie (customer comms). Follow-up in #product after PR merge. :thumbsup:
